messages.subject: Setting shiny preferences
parts:
In RStudio one can set preferences in a text file named rsession.conf and/or rserver.conf and stored in a sourced directory (where depends on your configuration and/or OS). 

My question is: can I "bind" RStudio to a specific browser? Purpose: launch my shiny apps in a browser of my choice (one that has an "inspect element" feature for instance), without changing the default browser for my entire system.

FYI, I use Mac OSX 10.8, Windows 7, and kUbuntu 13.10.

Here are examples of content of reserver.conf

# RStudio listens to port:
www-port=80

# RStudio binds to address:
www-address=127.0.0.1

Reference:
http://www.rstudio.com/ide/docs/server/configuration
